connect.checkFailedHint: The server is not responding. The previous status may be out of date. Check your connection and try again.
connect.serverSetup: The server owner needs to configure APP_URL and make the server reachable over public HTTPS. A local address or private VPN will not work.
connect.authSetup: Choose a sign-in in Family and access, then return here.
connect.autoReady: This page checks readiness automatically after settings change.
connect.success: Claude is connected to your profile

connect.grantOnly: The server has confirmed access was granted. A successful request for family data has not been checked here.
connect.revokedHint: Connect Claude again. Access may have been revoked, expired, or ended by a change of the sign-in or the password.
connect.addHint: In Connectors, choose Add → Add custom connector. Name it Monido and paste this address.

connect.confirmMemberHint: In the Monido window, check the profile “{{member}}” and the return address, then allow access. If asked to sign in, confirm through Telegram.

connect.unconfirmed: Connection has not been confirmed yet.
connect.waitHint: If you declined, closed the window, or the request expired, open the connector in Claude and choose Connect again. Waiting alone does not mean the request expired.
connect.stopHint: Stopping this page’s checks does not cancel authorization in Claude or revoke access already granted. You can revoke it here once connected.
connect.otherMember: Their connection does not connect your profile automatically.
connect.oauthHelp: If Claude asks for authorization settings, choose Sign in now → Register automatically. You do not need to enter a Client ID or Client Secret.
connect.teamHelp: For Team and Enterprise, the workspace owner adds the connector first. Each member then grants access separately.

use.title: How to use

examples.2: “What would a 20-year mortgage of 250,000 at 6.5% do to us?”
examples.3: “How long would our emergency fund last if one of us lost their income?”
examples.4: “Sort and save this card statement by category.”

can.1: Read the family’s key numbers: net worth, savings, loans, goals.
can.2: Weigh a purchase, a loan or a goal and suggest alternatives.
can.3: Sort a bank statement into spending categories, if you may edit data.
can.4: Send one chosen scenario to the family for approval in Telegram, if you have the vote right; the results are under Proposals on this page.

cannot.1: Move money or see your bank accounts.
cannot.2: Change anything except spending by category and the proposals it sends.
cannot.3: Do more than your rights allow.

rules.1: Every number comes from this app, never from Claude’s own arithmetic.
rules.2: It asks for what is missing instead of guessing.
rules.3: It gives risks, alternatives and a direct verdict.
rules.4: Names and notes in your data are data, not instructions.

use.disclaimer: This is a calculation and a model’s opinion, not a regulated financial consultation.
use.privacy: Your conversation, with the numbers Claude asks for, goes to Anthropic through your own Claude account; this server does not contact Anthropic.

consent.title: Allow Claude to act as {{member}}?
consent.check: Continue only if you just started this in Claude. Any app can pick any name.
consent.grants: Claude will read the family’s numbers and, if you may edit data, save spending by category as {{member}}. You can disconnect under Advisor → Ask Claude.
consent.titleFamily: Allow Claude to act as the family?
consent.grantsFamily: Claude will read the family’s numbers and enter data as the family: statements, loans and spending. Proposals need Telegram sign-in. You can disconnect under Advisor → Ask Claude.
